item: The launcher-rows test waits for the filter's summary rows; the exposure is stated
summary: Before: test_the_rows_are_the_bytes_they_were_before_the_lock read the file straight after the launcher exited and lost a loaded run to the stderr filter (a process substitution that writes its summary row after the launcher exits). After: it polls up to its existing 20 s for the two summary rows. LIMIT stated: the filter finishes 0-9 ms after the launcher on an idle machine (22 launches, 17 Oct); no figure exists under load; a closed terminal does not lose the row (the filter ignores HUP), only a SIGKILL to the whole process group inside that window does. The launcher's exit path is unchanged by ruling.
